vetSays.line: 🛡️ Norman, Mateo, Elijah and Petra met them at the door — 4 put down. Norman, Mateo, Elijah, Petra are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Isaac, Elijah and Petra met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Isaac, Elijah are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ming just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ming, Isaac, Naledi, Elijah and Nadia met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 driven off. Ming, Naledi, Nadia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naledi just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Isaac, Naledi, Elijah, Nadia and Petra met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Naledi, Elijah, Nadia, Petra are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Isaac just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Ines taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Ines passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.

◈ THE WAR PATH — The System pauses — actually pausing. It keeps a list of every tooth pulled, and for once it reads the list instead of the press release. On day 85, Diana put down Big Big. On day 84, Diana put down The Ugly Beast.

"THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced The Ugly Beast and lived to sit here. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans)." — the System is still reading the list.
